name: io.github.casareanderson/zima-mcp
title: Zima MCP
description: Check load, containers, logs and disks on a ZimaBlade or Docker host over SSH, restart allowlisted

environmentVariables.name: ZIMA_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname or IP of the box to manage

environmentVariables.name: ZIMA_USER
environmentVariables.description: SSH user that can run docker without sudo

environmentVariables.name: ZIMA_SSH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SSH private key (default: your SSH agent/config)

environmentVariables.name: ZIMA_SSH_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds before an SSH command gives up

environmentVariables.name: ZIMA_RESTART_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated containers the agent may restart; empty = restarts refused
